oh-county-officials.summary: The County card names the county you picked, and not its commissioners or other elected officers. The card says so rather than leave the offices looking empty.
oh-county-officials.why: No statewide list of Ohio's county officials has been read for this app yet, and the counties' own pages have not been read one by one.
oh-county-officials.wanted: One statewide list of each county's commissioners and other elected officers, or a county's own published list of them.

oh-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City or Village card names the place you picked, and not its mayor or council members.
oh-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of the elected officials of Ohio's cities and villages has been read for this app, and their own pages have not been read one by one.
oh-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of each city's and village's mayor and council members, or a place's own published list of them.

oh-school-board-members.summary: The School District card names the district you picked, and not the members of its board of education.
oh-school-board-members.why: No list of the members of Ohio's school boards has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
oh-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's board members, or a district's own published list of its board.

oh-townships.summary: The map does not draw Ohio's townships or name their trustees and fiscal officers. Outside a city or village, the township and the county are the local governments, and the City or Village card says so.
oh-townships.why: No township layer has been built for this app, and no list of the people each township elects has been read.
oh-townships.wanted: A statewide list of each township's trustees and fiscal officer, or a township's own published list, to name on a township layer drawn from the Census's township lines.
